nodes.summary: Generate one image from a text prompt through the gpt-image-2.5 image API and save it on this host. Returns the absolute path and a ready-to-send [CQ:image,file=<path>] snippet; pass that snippet to qq_send to show the picture. The same bytes are also cached at data/media/<sha256>.png, and the returned sha256 lets the agent re-read the picture with view_image.

prompt.description: What to draw: subject, style, composition, wording of any text.

model.description: Optional image model: 'flare' (default) or 'sunburst'; a full model id is also accepted.

quality.description: Optional quality hint passed to the API (e.g. low, medium, high).

path.description: Absolute path of the rendered file on this host

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the rendered bytes; pass it to view_image as sha256:<digest>

media_path.description: Cache address of the same bytes, e.g. data/media/<sha256>.png

media_cached.description: Whether the media cache write succeeded; false is diagnostic only and the generated image is still returned

side_effects: writes one image file under the configured output directory
writes the same bytes to the content-addressed media cache data/media/<sha256>.png
makes a POST to the image API
failure_modes: media cache not writable (logged as a diagnostic; the image is still returned)

system_hint:
生图（image_gen）：有人要你画图、生成图片、做图时用它。
【调用】invoke_plugin {"plugin_path":"image_gen","node_id":"generate_image","payload_json":{"prompt":"<画面描述：主体、风格、构图、要出现的文字>","model":"flare"}}
【模型】model 可选 flare（默认）或 sunburst，是两种不同的出图模型；对方没指定就用默认，指定了另一种就换。
【结果】ok=true 时返回 path（本机绝对路径）、cq_image（[CQ:image,file=<path>]）和 sha256（这张图的内容摘要）。
【发图】把 cq_image 原样放进 qq_send 的 message，可以和说明文字同一条；不要只发路径、不要自己拼 base64、不要拿网图冒充。
【自查】生成时同一份字节已按内容寻址写进 data/media/<sha256>.png。想确认画面有没有崩，调 view_image {"sha256":"sha256:<sha256>"}（或 {"path":"data/media/<sha256>.png"}），图会挂到下一轮请求上。view_image 只读这台机器上已缓存的图片，不接受 URL；这条通道不是文件读取权限，也不给你写文件的能力。
【失败】ok=false 时 error 写明原因（token 未配置 / 上游拒绝 / 超时）。把原因简短告诉对方，同一轮不要反复重试同一条。
